Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pinebrook — vendor intake gating our demo next week

Hi Soojin,

Quick heads up — procurement pushed our internal approval timeline this morning. They won't sign off on a live vendor demo until we complete their online vendor intake: a short security questionnaire, an NDA on DocuSign, and an IDP/SAML SSO check. Legal also wants a SOC2 summary before execs sit in on vendor calls.

We had the 6/10 slot on the calendar for a 30-min technical walkthrough, but procurement says they need those items completed first. Can we either (A) move the live demo to a later date or (B) run a 20–25min prerecorded walkthrough earlier for our product team while procurement finishes intake?

Appreciate a quick note on what you need from us to move forward.

Thanks,
Tom
-----
Tom Ellis
Senior PM, Integrations
Pinebrook Health

Subject: Re: Pinebrook — vendor intake gating our demo next week

Hi Tom —

Totally understood, thanks for flagging. We can do both: record a short walkthrough for your product folks this week, and push the live technical sandbox session until procurement confirms portal clearance.

What I can do right now:
- Attach a completed copy of our SOC 2 summary and a prep draft NDA for your legal (attached).
- Attach the vendor intake questionnaire that Procurement mentioned; if your team fills it and uploads to their portal we’ll coordinate with Vendor Portal support.
- Ben (cc'd) will record a 20-minute targeted walkthrough (UI + integration notes + sample prompts) and share a private link by EOD Thursday.

If procurement still wants a live session with IDP/SAML validation, we'll need the SSO metadata and a contact at your IdP (or we can test in a temporary dev org). Can you also confirm whether the Execs still want to attend the live session or whether they'll wait for a follow-up summary?

Proposed placeholder for the live demo once intake is cleared: the week of 6/21 — we can offer Tue/Wed afternoon PST. If that won't work for Execs, tell us preferred windows and we'll hold.

Links / next steps I've seeded into the thread: DocuSign NDA (if legal wants to use the draft) and the vendor questionnaire file.

Thanks —
Sooj

--

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Recorded walkthrough + attachments (Pinebrook)

Hi Tom / Soojin —

Attached: Pinebrook_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (filled with placeholder answers where we need your input) and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. Also dropping a short Loom link to the recorded walkthrough: https://loom.com/share/short-demo-pinebrook.

What to expect in the recording:
- 0:00–02:30: quick product orientation and context for your integration team
- 02:30–08:00: sample prompt flows and latency/cost expectations for typical Pinebrook workloads
- 08:00–18:30: connector walkthrough (API keys, sample payloads, and KV caching behavior)
- 18:30–20:00: next steps and recommended checklist to pass procurement gating

Ops notes: if Procurement uploads the questionnaire to their portal (or shares a portal ticket), include support@vendorportal.com in the CC so they can validate evidence. For SSO testing, send us SAML metadata (or an SP-initiated test user) and we’ll validate in our staging tenant — it usually takes one business day to confirm.

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync if you want to talk through the questionnaire together.

Cheers,
Ben

- Legal reviewed your draft NDA and sent minor redlines via DocuSign (link above). We also uploaded the vendor questionnaire into our portal this morning; you should receive a ticket and an upload request (cc'd support@vendorportal.com).
- For the SSO check: our IdP contact is Raj Patel (raj.patel@pinebrookhealth.org). Raj can share metadata and a test account on Thursday.
- Execs prefer the prerecorded walkthrough this Friday (6/11) and will schedule for the live sandbox session the week of 6/21, prefer Wed 6/23 1:30pm PT if that works on your side.

Can you confirm you received the portal ticket and that the recording link is accessible? If we hit any upload errors I'll escalate to Vendor Portal support (cc).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice
